headline: PHI @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 3.66 at SDP 3.19, with a projected total of 6.85. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (PHI -0.53, SDP -0.42), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.95, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Jesús Luzardo has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alec Bohm, Miguel Andujar, Bryson Stott, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adolis García, Justin Crawford because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
